# scon_operation (Resource)

The operation records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_id` (String)
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `code` (String) Tengo; empty or null inherits the template code. http operations and in operations off the call trigger need code
- `config` (Dynamic)
- `direction` (String)
- `events` (List of String) Required on the event trigger, emptied on every other
- `input_schema` (Dynamic)
- `kinds` (List of String) Slugs from `GET /api/kinds`
- `output_schema` (Dynamic)
- `poll_seconds` (Number) 0 or at least 10
- `state` (String)
- `transport` (String) in: pull, webhook, stream, mqtt, kafka; out: http, webhook, mqtt, kafka, teams, slack, email
- `trigger` (String) interval runs in operations only, event out operations only
